name: Mottainai
summary: Buddhist temple card game where players complete works to cover helpers in a Gallery and sales in a Gift Shop.
rules_text: Each player has a temple mat with Task, Helpers, Craft bench and Sales tucked underneath, plus two wings. Five card hand, one task card and a shared deck and floor discard. On your turn: Morning - if hand >5 return to bottom until 5, trigger morning effects, discard old task from slot to floor, optionally tuck a new task from hand face-down. Noon - perform every opponent's task clockwise then your own; if you have no task take Prayer. A task gives 1 action plus 1 per matching helper, 2 if helper is covered by Gallery work. Actions: Clerk moves a card from Craft bench to Sales, Monk takes a card from Floor to Helpers, Tailor discards any number from hand then draws to waiting area to total 5, Potter takes Floor card to Craft bench, Smith completes a work from hand using matching support from hand, Craft completes work from hand using support from Craft bench, Prayer draws to waiting area. Work values: Paper 1 needs 0, Stone/Cloth 2 needs 1, Clay/Metal 3 needs 2. Completed work goes to Gallery covering helpers or Gift Shop covering sales. Night - trigger night effects, then waiting area enters hand. Game ends immediately when deck empties or a player has 5 works in one wing. Score work values + covered sales values + backorder majority bonuses per material.
rating_reason: card crafting bluffing game fits hidden hands engine
